# Publish gate report

**Going out:** creator post, paid, UK audience. Timing and recipient list not specified.

## Checks

**1. Claims.** "Packed by hand in Bristol" is on the policy list ("every tin is packed by hand in Bristol"). "Assam" is a product fact, fine as written. No stats, superlatives, guarantees or testimonials beyond the creator's own opinion ("which I love"), which is a personal view and acceptable. Pass.

**2. Regulated claims.** "Afternoon reset" and "ten minutes away from my phone" are lifestyle phrasing, not health claims (no treating, relaxing-as-medical-benefit, or wellbeing outcome promised). No money, environment, children or price claims. Pass.

**3. House style.** The policy has no voice section, so I can't score against a reference. Reading it plainly: it is short, specific and natural. "Afternoon reset" is slightly stock, but it's the creator's own voice and I wouldn't change it. Pass.

**4. Disclosure.** Fail. The channel is marked as a paid creator post, and the draft has no label at all. UK rules (ASA/CAP, CMA) expect a clear, upfront label on paid partnerships, before the reader engages, not buried at the end or in a hashtag pile.

## Fixed
- Nothing changed in the wording. The disclosure fix needs to go in at the start, and I'd rather you confirm the exact label with the creator than have me guess the platform tooling.

Suggested version:

> **Ad | Paid partnership with Pebblebrook Tea Co.**
> My afternoon reset is a pot of Pebblebrook's Assam and ten minutes away from my phone. Their tins are packed by hand in Bristol, which I love.

Also switch on the platform's own paid-partnership / branded-content tool, if the channel has one.

## Needs a decision
- **Label wording and placement:** confirm "Ad" or "Paid partnership" at the very start of the post (my suggestion above). Needs to be repeated on every post if this is part of a series.
- **Approver:** the policy names no approver, so approval comes from you as the user. I need an explicit yes to the exact final text with the label included. Nothing here has been approved yet.

**Status: not ready to publish.** One blocking issue (missing disclosure). Once the label is added and you approve the final text, it can go.
